newsitem.title: CANADA: Syncrude says set industry output record in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Syncrude says set industry output record in Sept.

text.p: Syncrude Canada Ltd, the world's largest producer of synthetic crude oil, said on Tuesday it shipped a company record seven million barrels of oil in September, 300,000 barrels above the same month last year.
The company, a consortium of nine energy firms, also said it set a daily record on September 28 by shipping 248,000 barrels of the crude produced from oil sands.
The previous record was set in May when 247,000 barrels were moved.
Syncrude chief operating officer Jim Carter said the operation, located in northern Alberta, was on track to meet its production target of 75 million barrels for 1996.

Syncrude's partners include Imperial Oil Ltd, Petro-Canada, Gulf Canada Resources Ltd, Athabasca Oil Sands Investments Inc, Canadian Oil Sands Investments Inc, Alberta Energy Co Ltd, Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd, Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd unit Mocal Energy Ltd and Murphy Oil Corp.
